textRuns.value: This table shows the average number of tenants in a property at any stage in the FY. This number should be treated as an estimate due to the way the data is captured. Households can regularly change with people moving in and out, however, these people do not necessarily have a record and often only a number of people in the household at any one time is captured. For this formula, we take the maximum number of people that lived in a property at any one time during the selected Financial Year and use that to form the calculation.
If you have a slicer on Gender or Ethnicity, please be aware that this only applies to the
tenant and in some cases may not be useful.
